adr: ADR-0005 D3 (locus rule + Stage-2 operating point), D5 (block-level CI), D7 (benchmark decoy prevalence + sweep), A7 (which decoy pools were trained on), A11 Pin 4 (Stage-1 read on the uncalibrated posterior), A12 (the P2 checkpoint is canonical); ADR-0004 A6 (eval twin / two-run split); ADR-0005 A15 (screened re-mint, leader_decoy reported beside the gate, power clause, familiarity baseline, Stage-2 identity)

excluded_pools.gc_background: superseded for training by the 15,708 real mined genomic windows; a 0th-order i.i.d. surrogate built at P0 when no genome panel existed. Retained unchanged as the ADR-0005 D7 GATE-1 benchmark denominator.
excluded_pools.leader_decoy: label collision: all 8 records are T-box-derived and 2 are exact substrings of training-corpus positives. Re-sourcing deferred to P2-10b′ (ADR-0005 A7 re-scopes D14's leader-pool retention clause).

scope.gated_rule: ADR-0005 A15 Pin 4 — leader_decoy minted and scored, reported beside the gate
scope.geometry: 1024-nt scan windows (ADR-0005 D3 / PRD §6 pinned geometry)

overlap_with_training_folds.method: verbatim forward-strand k-mers of the host portion (spliced insert excluded; the flanks either side of it are read separately, so no k-mer spans the excision) against the arm's own Stage-1 training-fold context_seq; any k-mer containing a non-ACGT character is skipped on both sides (ADR-0005 A15 Pin 1 alphabet rule: an N-run is not shared DNA)

host_pool.selection: parent_nested_train == False, then admitted by the ADR-0005 A15 host screen: Pin 1 fold screen (whole pre-splice window, canonical N-free 32-mers on either strand against the union of every Stage-1/Stage-2 training sequence plus every decoys_v0 insert, or a same-accession training-interval overlap) and Pin 2 content screen (RF00230/TBDB001 cmsearch >= 10.0 bits, or the GGTGGNACCGCG motif), applied BEFORE the seeded draw; see screen and overlap_with_training_folds

insert_exposure.rule: ADR-0005 A15 Pin 7(c) — a gated negative's decoys_v0 insert (U->T, upper-cased) equal in sequence to the rna_sequence of a decoy row in the shipped Stage-2 training population (stage2.train.select_rows at the train rung). By SEQUENCE, never by id: every test-rung decoy is out of that population by id, so an id comparison is 0 by construction.

scope.negative_construction: data/embedding.py::embed_decoy_rows — the shipped ADR-0005 A7 splice, all four §9.1 pools, unique hosts, hosts drawn parent_nested_train == False and admitted by the ADR-0005 A15 host screen before the draw

disclosures: The gated arm is the GATE-4 eval twin, not the shipped scanner. The shipped P2-10d′-b checkpoint trained on 1201 of the 1201 benchmark positives; the twin saw 0. §7 decision 2026-08-13; ADR-0004 A6's two-run split is the same instrument GATE-4 used.

The production arm's numbers are REPORTED, NOT GATED. Its Stage-1 is in-sample on every positive, which flatters the Stage-1-only system, so a pass there is conservative and a fail there is uninterpretable.

The gated denominator holds 691 negatives from 3 §9.1 pool(s) (structured_rna 283, gc_background 206, dinuc_shuffled 202). The 1 leader_decoy item(s) are minted, scored and reported BESIDE the gate (ADR-0005 A15 Pin 4; every leader_decoy record is T-box-derived, A7 Pin 5). §9.1's class 4 has no genuine records (P2-10b′ deferred); the non-delivery is disclosed, not absorbed (A7).

This grade supersedes the withdrawn v1 grade (reports/two_stage_precision.json, kept byte-unchanged as its record; ADR-0005 A15 Pin 5). v1's pass was carried by decoys whose hosts hold RF00230-detectable sequence.

Host screen (ADR-0005 A15 Pins 1–2): of 27941 candidate host windows, 4721 were refused for sharing an N-free canonical 32-mer with the screened training DNA and 83 for a same-accession training-interval overlap; 305 survivors were refused for an RF00230/TBDB001 hit >= 10.0 bits or the motif GGTGGNACCGCG, leaving 22914 to draw from; 12 of 12 must-fire controls fired. The drawn hosts' measured overlap with each arm's Stage-1 fold is production 0, twin 0. The refusal count lower-bounds T-box content in the pool; a passing screen is NOT a claim the pool is clean (sub-threshold or CM-invisible content is unseen).

CM circularity and scope (ADR-0005 A15 Pin 7(a)): after the content screen a gated negative MEANS below 10.0 bits on RF00230/TBDB001 and free of GGTGGNACCGCG, so a CM contestant is favoured by construction (P3-17a's confirmer; GATE-1's cmsearch baseline), and a learned model that finds a real but CM-invisible T-box in a gated host is scored as a false positive. This benchmark grades Stage-1-vs-two-stage integration on an in-distribution, CM-screened negative set; it is never evidence about novel-element recall, FDR or held-out-clade generalization, and it is not quoted beside a GATE-1 or P5 claim without this sentence.

Flank familiarity (ADR-0005 A15 Pin 7(b)): scoring each gated item by the fraction of its 32-mers present in the gated arm's own Stage-1 training DNA reaches AUPRC 0.996714 at 100:1, against Stage-1-only 0.997527 and two-stage 0.997527 (-0.081 pp vs Stage-1-only). Every gated host is screened 32-mer-disjoint from training DNA while the positives' flanks mostly are not, and the twin's training negatives include flank windows of the gated positives (ADR-0004 A4 admits on parent_nested_train, not on each arm's fold). It does not rival Stage-1.

Insert-level exposure (ADR-0005 A15 Pin 7(c)): structured_rna inserts seen in Stage-1 training — gated arm 283 of 283, production 283 of 283; dinuc_shuffled inserts seen by production 100 of 202; 16 test inserts duplicate a Stage-2 training decoy.

The shipped Stage-2 trained on T-box-derived leader_decoy records labelled negative (A7 Pin 5's contradiction, outside A7's Stage-1 scope; ADR-0005 A15 Pin 7(d)). The leader's beside-gate read is dec:neg_tbdb_3jwbBIlK two-stage 0.000486, Stage-1-only 0.997457 on the gated arm, and it is read in that light.

Composition shift (ADR-0005 A15 Pin 7(e)): v2's drawn hosts — n_hosts 692; parent_is_designated_loo_holdout: true 457, false 235; parent_nested_role: heldout 460, excluded_clade_crossing 211, dropped 21; parent_resolved_order: Lactobacillales 282, Bacillales 108, Clostridiales 103, Tissierellales 29, Corynebacteriales 27, null 21, … (+26 more); side: lead 400, trail 292 — against v1's hosts — n 692; parent_is_designated_loo_holdout: true 395, false 297; parent_nested_role: heldout 399, excluded_clade_crossing 271, dropped 22; parent_resolved_order: Lactobacillales 251, Bacillales 161, Clostridiales 109, Corynebacteriales 22, null 22, Erysipelotrichales 18, … (+27 more); side: trail 348, lead 344.

no gated negative reached Stage-2; the benchmark has no power to test Stage-2: 0 of 691 gated negatives carry a Stage-1 candidate in the gated arm. The benchmark holds no negative either system can discriminate — this is NOT 'two-stage did not beat Stage-1-only'. The A13 verdict is recorded unchanged (a tie fails the strict >).

The ADR-0005 D7 100:1 prevalence is reached by REWEIGHTING the sampled negatives, not by materialising them — the gated population's own composition is 0.575 decoys per positive. conf/data/decoys.yaml scopes the D7 pin to P4; it is reported here because imp.md's P3-16 block asks for it, and the matched-recall verdict is checked invariant across the whole 10:1 → 10⁴:1 sweep.

Benchmark items are 1024-nt scan windows (ADR-0005 D3 / PRD §6 pinned geometry): a positive is its gate4_eval locus carved in real ±genomic context, a negative is a §9.1 decoy spliced into a screened real mined host window by the shipped embed_decoy_rows. The gated arm admits 0 of 691 gated negatives and retains 0 at matched recall (production 0/0 for the arms reported beside it). This is an in-distribution reference, not a genome-scale scan simulation (P5).

ADR-0005 D3 freezes the Stage-1 threshold, the locus knobs and the Stage-2 operating point at the §13.1 phase gate (P5-01). Nothing here pins any of them; the knobs this run used are recorded under sources.rule_knobs.

familiarity_baseline.score: fraction of the item contig's canonical 32-mers present in the arm's own Stage-1 training DNA (fold context_seq, the admitted mined windows, the embedded decoy inserts) — ADR-0005 A15 Pin 7(b)

gate.definition: PRD §18.1 P3 exit — two-stage beats Stage-1-only precision on the in-distribution benchmark, graded (ADR-0005 A13) on the THRESHOLD-FREE statistic: AUPRC at the D7 pinned decoy prevalence, PRD §12's primary imbalance-aware metric

reported_not_gated.why: ADR-0005 D3 freezes the Stage-1 threshold and the Stage-2 operating point at P5-01, two phases after this gate; the matched-recall read is therefore reported at the values this run used and gated on neither

gate.underpowered_statement: no gated negative reached Stage-2; the benchmark has no power to test Stage-2

power.rule: ADR-0005 A15 Pin 5 — score-blind: gated negatives with >= 1 Stage-1 candidate, and with >= 1 Stage-2 payload; underpowered iff the gated arm's first count is 0
power.sentence: no gated negative reached Stage-2; the benchmark has no power to test Stage-2

reported_not_gated.rule: ADR-0005 A15 Pin 4 — leader_decoy is minted and scored, and reported beside the gate; it is filtered out of the gated denominator at the precision-report call site, before arm_metrics
